node.title: Uniform corank-two projective-basis cap
node.closure: requires structure beyond support-local transversality at t>=1
node.statement: Prove or refute that every official rank-eleven kernel corank-two canonical-basis chart has at most 84416263 records. This value is proved only at complete shortening; the current valid integer-gap envelope gives 253238254 at K'=377674.
